name: Lumen Pastoral Studios
description: Vantablack's dedicated children's programming subsidiary, producing neural-feed content rated for BCI users aged six and older under the Sable Charter's Juvenile Immersion Guidelines. Lumen Pastoral's content is aggressively optimistic, featuring synthesized natural environments, aspirational tier-climbing narratives, and subtle brand integration for HelixCorp and Axiom products. Their flagship series 'Little Luma Gets Her Light' is among the most-watched children's properties in Meridian history.
cultural_impact: Raised at least two generations of Tier 2-3 children on aspirational content that equates personal worth with tier ascent, producing measurable shifts in how working-class youth conceptualize social mobility.
story_hooks: A child psychologist has compiled evidence of the conditioning algorithms and needs help getting it to an independent journalist before her license is pulled
An adult who grew up on Lumen Pastoral content begins experiencing intrusive brand-loyalty responses during a mission that targets an Axiom facility
The original creative lead of Lumen Pastoral was removed and has been trying to contact someone — anyone — for three years
